items.title: Native Windows startup
items.detail: The package uses local assets, opens the ordinary game window and loads the room.

items.title: 319 opening frames
items.detail: All 319 consecutive 480×272 RGB frames match for the recorded input sequence. This result covers the opening logos.

items.title: Title menu and reveal
items.detail: Select Menu leads to Poképi selection. Four points in the reveal were compared.

items.title: Local asset loading
items.detail: The build extracts the required archives from a local ISO. The Windows package starts from a fresh extraction.

items.title: Fonts and Japanese text
items.detail: The ordinary window displays dialogue, menu labels and a name from a notebook entry.

items.title: Game updates and timers
items.detail: Room tests verified waits, actual activity start and resumption after dialogue.

items.title: Suspend and resume
items.detail: The Windows sleep handler pauses the game clock and PCM. A headless Release test resumed at the next frame after a simulated hour of sleep. Physical wake remains unverified.

items.title: Window and framebuffer
items.detail: The ordinary Win32 window presents 480×272 frames and handles WM_CLOSE.

items.title: Backgrounds, menus and layers
items.detail: The title reveal, dialogue windows, inventory and notebook run through their normal paths.

items.title: Room geometry, materials and lighting
items.detail: The room, item models and seasonal lighting work. Shadow and arbitrary-frame parity remain open.

items.title: Poképi rigs and animation
items.detail: All five models load in component tests. Kuro's commands also run in Toro's events.

items.title: EF9 effect in Toro's farewell
items.detail: Two runs of the original EF9 model and animation completed. Eight frames differed from a control with a transparent texture.

items.title: Other DAK visual events
items.detail: EF1–EF4 and EF9 run from the original DAK trigger through rendering and cleanup. Tests covered 13 selected ASC commands on six models and Toro's normal farewell.

items.title: Camera and speech placement
items.detail: Checks covered approach, the dialogue shot, the return to a wide shot and the next turn.

items.title: Roof and scene transitions
items.detail: Home, roof, panorama and return work. Component tests covered three roof resource variants.

items.title: Other game scenes
items.detail: 54 scene registrations rendered in memory. All 15 destinations in Toro's ordinary list supported travel and return. Robo, Usagi, Inu and Kaeru each travelled to their default destination twice and returned. Some destination effects and additional routes remain open.

items.title: Keyboard input and cancel priority
items.detail: Normal keys work in menus, ASK prompts, editors and transitions. Tests cover new key presses and held buttons.

items.title: XInput controller support
items.detail: The Windows adapter, button layout and disconnect recovery were tested. Windows detected no physical device across its four ports.

items.title: Background music
items.detail: Native Windows voices, event-triggered BGM and track changes. Tests run with a null audio sink.

items.title: Sound effects and volume
items.detail: Coverage includes menu cues, actor sounds and SE/BGM volume controls.

items.title: Silent test output
items.detail: A fresh Release build verified PCM, looping, pause, volume and completion through the null sink.

items.title: libatrac3plus and decoding
items.detail: The native Windows FFmpeg path consumes original ATRAC data. The check covers high-level decoding.

items.title: audiocodec and Media Engine contract
items.detail: The native worker allocates the input buffer, opens the decoder, verifies PCM and releases decoder state. Tests covered 25 ATRAC3 streams and the ATRAC3+ SND0.

items.title: sc_sascore and mixing
items.detail: Windows handles game voices and volume controls. Full PSP API coverage remains open.

items.title: ifhandle
items.detail: The Windows host discovers a peer instance. Interface selection and delivery were tested on loopback.

items.title: pspnet
items.detail: Two independent Windows processes used Winsock for discovery, connection and bidirectional transfer.

items.title: memab
items.detail: The host negotiates an ephemeral key and protects data with AES-GCM. Tests rejected altered packets, mismatched keys and invalid frame numbers.

items.title: pspnet_adhoc_auth
items.detail: Two processes confirm the same session key before trading. Checks cover version, mode, location and both IDs.

items.title: pspnet_adhoc
items.detail: The transport sent 2048 bytes in each direction and exchanged in-game cards between two instances.

items.title: pspnet_adhocctl
items.detail: Tests covered matching mode and location, rejecting a different mode, peer closure and cancelling a wait to return to the room.

items.title: Poképi selection and profile setup
items.detail: The carousel uses the game models. Profile entry covers nickname, player name, gender, date and other fields. Toro's native window route was verified.

items.title: Toro's arrival and introduction
items.detail: The first conversation, gift, placement choice and farewell lead to an activity in the room.

items.title: Toro's ordinary days
items.detail: Independent processes verified the natural day 1 to day 2 rollover, a learned word and diary, saving and reloading.

items.title: Toro's penultimate day
items.detail: Kuro, four choices, return to activity, protected save and independent continuation on day 13.

items.title: Toro's last day
items.detail: The ordinary day 14 departure exercised seven choices, two EF9 flashes, GAME75 completion, protected saving and a cold load into the title menu. Frames were rendered to memory.

items.title: Toro's extended stay and return
items.detail: Controlled slots verified extension to day 24, cold return, the penultimate day with Kuro and a protected final save. The former event 7 gap is tracked separately in acceptance.

items.title: Robo's story
items.detail: Tests covered the introduction, both penultimate days with Kuro, ordinary day 14 departure, extension, return and day 24 farewell. A cold load after farewell opened the empty room and vocabulary.

items.title: Usagi's story
items.detail: Tests covered the introduction, day 13 with Kuro, ordinary departure, extension to day 24 and cold loading after departure. Broad conversation coverage is tracked separately.

items.title: Inu's story
items.detail: Tests covered the introduction, day 13 with Kuro, ordinary departure, extension to day 24 and cold loading after departure. Broad conversation coverage is tracked separately.

items.title: Kaeru's story
items.detail: Tests covered the introduction, day 13 with Kuro, ordinary departure, extension to day 24 and cold loading after departure. Broad conversation coverage is tracked separately.

items.title: Departure, title and replay
items.detail: Cold Continue from the farewell save opens the empty room. Tests checked a learned word through the restricted menu and returning to the title. Re-adoption is tracked separately in acceptance.

items.title: Autonomous activities
items.detail: The current context selects a command. The actor starts, finishes and begins a new activity cycle.

items.title: Calendar, lighting and daily events
items.detail: The game uses its clock and season and processes day rollover. A Windows run crossed midnight without changing system time.

items.title: Ordinary conversation
items.detail: Greeting, topic selection, answers, dialogue, farewell and return to activity. Multiple consecutive contacts were verified.

items.title: Supported KSC commands
items.detail: Home routes execute the saved scripts natively and report unsupported operations.

items.title: Other KSC procedures and topics
items.detail: All 3118 ordinary entries across the five Poképi returned on the controlled route, 3094 directly and 24 after a normal topic change. Other states and special scripts have partial coverage.

items.title: TV and scene lighting
items.detail: A component test verified directional lighting changes driven by TV state.

items.title: Inventory and placement
items.detail: The flow covers a real gift, inspection, placement, storage, cancel and reopening.

items.title: Discarding gifts
items.detail: Yes removes the item from both lists. Declining preserves the item and focus.

items.title: Marking gifts for exchange
items.detail: A marked gift appears in the relevant tab and can be unmarked.

items.title: Options
items.detail: Text speed, sound effects and music. The same session covers cancel, decline, apply and reopen.

items.title: Roof outing and return
items.detail: The normal route goes from the room to the roof and back. Toro starts an autonomous activity after arrival.

items.title: Roof interactions
items.detail: Dialogue with choices, notebook, diary and return to the same location.

items.title: Word lessons
items.detail: Learn a word, choose its category, see the response and record it. Ordinary conversation can reuse the word.

items.title: On-screen layouts and cancel
items.detail: Kana, alternate layout, ABC and digits. Tests cover an empty entry, the 16-character limit and cancel.

items.title: NJ conversion and history
items.detail: Cold and warm candidate lists, compound readings and reranking after a selection within the session.

items.title: Expanded NJ lookup and persistent history
items.detail: Hiragana queries up to eight characters search 57,718 entries using NJCON grammar. History survives save and reload. Full PSP ranking, NJYOMI and multi-block entries remain open.

items.title: Word memo
items.detail: Reading and date tabs, editing a reading, declining and confirming deletion, and reusing the freed slot.

items.title: Diary
items.detail: Blank daytime page, evening reveal and previous pages after cold loading. Coverage is limited to the recorded dates.

items.title: Protected saving and Continue
items.detail: Six files are written and copied. Windows and the quiet reference loaded the transferred slot. A failed write preserves the previous generation.

items.title: Room state and vocabulary
items.detail: Toro's graph restores vocabulary, inventory, placed items, questions and counters through their owners.

items.title: Late and alternate saves
items.detail: Tests for all five characters covered ordinary departure, extension and skipping the final day. Toro-to-Robo adoption preserved a learned word and a test friend card across System Save and cold load.

items.title: Friends menu and prepared questions
items.detail: Prepare a preset or custom question, remove it, and reopen the question card on the roof.

items.title: Shiritori eligibility
items.detail: Word lessons and editing a final kana ん change eligibility. Tests covered the offer, destination choices and cancelling the meeting.

items.title: Two-player meeting
items.detail: Two players chose the same place and opened a shared session. With no partner, Escape restored room control and activity.

items.title: Card exchange
items.detail: Both instances displayed the peer card in the notebook, wrote a protected save and opened it after cold loading.

items.title: Gift exchange
items.detail: Two processes chose gifts, received their peer's item and checked both items after System Save and cold load. Cancellation preserved the previous item.

items.title: Playing shiritori
items.detail: Two ordinary game controllers played six words from test vocabularies. Tests covered win, loss, remembering used words and cancellation.
